advisory.finding: The new CLI verb `attach_commits_cli` has no test coverage: neither the missing-args path (exit code 2), the success `ATTACHED: ...` stdout, nor the RebarError->CommandError(returncode=1) translation is exercised, despite exit-codes.md now documenting `attach-commits` as `missing args -> 2; an unresolvable SHA -> 1`.

dropped.finding: The file-impact-vs-diff close gate is never exercised through a real close. The only tests drive `_check_file_impact_vs_diff` via the `det` fixture, which monkeypatches all four collaborators (`_union_file_impact`, `_attached_commit_shas`, `is_merge_commit`, `changed_paths`); the existing end-to-end close tests use `--allow-empty` commits (empty diff), so the new gate never blocks a real close on a genuine undeclared changed path.
scenarios: A regression breaking how _check_work_landed passes accepted_ids/referencing into the diff check, or how a real attached commit's paths are read, would not be caught since only the isolated helper is tested.
